description: Architected and deployed an end-to-end bespoke tailoring e-commerce and workshop management platform using Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4. Built a multi-role administrative suite (/admin, /order-admin, /content-admin) featuring biometric/PIN device authentication, karigar task queues, and seamless English/Marathi bilingual localization.
Engineered enterprise-grade WordPress integrations, Twilio SMS notification microservices, PDF cryptographic e-signature modules, and optimized CSV data importers with SQL cache tables.

Completed training in Git/GitHub, Agile frameworks, and WordPress core. Built the UFC plugin engineering 33 Gutenberg React blocks, dynamic video sliders with YouTube/Vimeo iframe bindings, and an AJAX notification system with custom SQL caching tables.
